sents.zh: 很久以前，一本书要一个字一个字地写。
sents.en: Long ago, a book had to be written out one character at a time.
Writing one book took many days.
So books were few, and expensive.

sents.zh: 后来，人们想到了一个好办法。
sents.en: Later, people thought of a good way.
They carved the characters onto wood.

sents.zh: 刻好以后，在上面放上黑色的墨。
sents.en: When it was carved, they put black ink on it.

sents.zh: 再把纸放上去，字就到纸上了。
sents.en: Then they laid paper on it, and the characters came onto the paper.

sents.zh: 这样，一天可以做出很多书。
sents.en: This way, many books could be made in a day.
